dual_timeframe.description: 双周期趋势交易策略 - 1H定方向，15m找入场，4H MACD做风控过滤

macd_v2_disable_short_filter.notes: Backtest-only profile: temporarily disable MACD V2 short quality filter when historical funding/OI fields are unavailable.

macd_v2_full_filters.notes: Backtest-only profile: keep MACD V2 short quality filter fully enabled for A/B comparison against the relaxed profile.

macd_v2_pure_4h_confirm_1h.notes: A/B profile: 4H decides trade direction, 1H is downgraded to same-side confirmation only, keeping the relaxed short-quality baseline consistent.

macd_v2_pure_4h_light_confirm_1h.notes: A/B profile: keep only 1H same-side confirmation plus BOLL structure guard; skip 1H-specific flip and quality vetoes under 4H-primary mode.

macd_v2_4h_preflip_trial_exit.notes: A/B profile: 4H-primary with 1H light confirmation, early pre-flip trial entries on 4H shrinking bars, and profit-protected 4H shrink exits.

macd_v2_4h_preflip_trial_exit_filter_a.notes: Profile A: conservative loss-pocket filter on top of the 4H pre-flip trial baseline. Blocks full-size short green_bar_growing entries in the 1H ADX 25-30 chop band, and blocks full-size long flip_bullish entries only when both the 15M upper-wick context is poor and the 1H CVD delta ratio fails to confirm.

macd_v2_4h_preflip_trial_exit_filter_b.notes: Profile B: broader loss-pocket filter on top of the 4H pre-flip trial baseline. Blocks full-size short green_bar_growing entries across the 1H ADX 20-30 zone, and blocks all full-size long flip_bullish entries whenever the 15M upper-wick ratio reaches 0.20 or higher.

macd_v2_4h_preflip_trial_exit_filter_a_v.notes: Profile V9: keep V8/A targeted filters, add 14:30-16:00 UTC lightweight session de-risking for short_dual_pressure and flip_bullish, expand 4H shrink exit to allow weak-loss early exits at -0.10%, and align consecutive-loss cooldown to 90 minutes.

Profile V9.1 session-only: keep V8/A entry and exit structure unchanged, add only 14:30-16:00 UTC session de-risking for short_dual_pressure and flip_bullish, and keep the original 30-minute consecutive-loss cooldown.
Profile V9.2A: keep V9.1 session-only structure, and add a second low-liquidity Asia session de-risk window at 03:00-05:30 UTC with 0.70 position scale.
Profile V9.2B: same two-session risk windows as V9.2A, but only de-risk short_dual_pressure so the session control stays focused on the main loss pocket.

macd_v2_v11_watchlist_throttle.notes: Profile V11/F1: keep V10 structure unchanged, but throttle the five attribution watchlist symbols with 40% max position, 2x max leverage, and extra 0.8x session scaling inside high-risk windows.

macd_v2_v11_watchlist_session_only.notes: Profile V11/F1a: do not globally cap watchlist symbols; only apply an extra 0.8x scale when those symbols also fall inside the existing high-risk session windows.

macd_v2_v11_vwap_score_tiers.notes: Profile V11/C1: keep V10 structure unchanged, but apply VWAP-score-based position scaling to short_dual_pressure and flip_bullish so weak VWAP locations use 0.8x, middle stays 1.0x, and strong VWAP locations can scale to 1.15x within symbol caps.

macd_v2_v11_preflip_symmetric_only.notes: Profile V11/B1: keep V10 unchanged except rebalance pre-flip shrink symmetry to long=0.60 and short=0.40, without any watchlist throttle.

macd_v2_v11_watchlist_throttle_preflip_s.notes: Profile V11/F1+B1: apply the watchlist throttle on top of V10, and rebalance pre-flip shrink symmetry to long=0.60 / short=0.40.

top100_binance_rot_20260319.notes: 2026-03-19 snapshot: validated risk-asset universe from the CoinGecko top-100 market-cap list intersected with Binance USDT perpetuals, with BTC/ETH/BNB explicitly included. Stable / tokenized-gold / ambiguous symbol-collision assets (for example USDC, PAXG, CC, WLFI, STABLE) are excluded. Backtest keeps max_active_symbols=3 and disables the MACD V2 short quality filter to stay aligned with the current relaxed default backtest baseline.

doge_first.notes: DOGE-only best backtest profile: +13.8% return, -3.0% max drawdown on the latest 30-day search.

doge_first_low_dd.notes: Lower-DD DOGE-only profile: +11.4% return, -2.5% max drawdown.

doge_sol_focus.notes: Best DOGE+SOL blend found in the focused search: +9.3% return, -5.5% max drawdown. Still weaker than DOGE-only.

btc_eth_hours_guard_tight_v2.notes: BTC+ETH tuned 30-day profile: +5.45% return, -3.12% max drawdown, PF 1.85 after excluding weak entry hours and tightening trend/volatility gates.

_notes.symbols_per_cycle: 0 = 每轮全扫全部 symbols；>0 = 单轮批大小(batch_size)，仍会在同一开仓窗口内分批扫完整个 universe，不再跨轮轮转截断。
_notes.symbol_stagger_seconds: 单个 symbol 之间的请求节流间隔。当前 0.2 秒，用于平滑 API 压力而不牺牲开仓覆盖。
_notes.symbols_batch_pause_seconds: 批次之间的额外暂停时间；仅当 symbols_per_cycle > 0 时有意义。
_notes.max_cycle_runtime_seconds: 0 = 不启用单轮超时截断，避免另一种形式的降载导致漏扫。
